messages.body:

Groetjes,
Sanne de Wit
Werkplaats Velomarkt Utrecht

Mara

messages.subject: K2 rear brake rattle

Hi Mara,

Quick one. Two of our K2 rentals came back with a squeal and a rattle from the rear brake after the rainy week we had. Pads look fine, rotor is true. One rider said it sounds like a loose part in the caliper. Is this a known issue? We pulled both from the rental fleet for now, which hurts on weekends.

Thanks,
Carla Mendes
Service Manager, Pedalworks Portland

messages.subject: Re: K2 rear brake rattle

Hi Carla,

Thanks for flagging, and sorry about the downtime. Engineering is looking at the rear brakes right now. I'll get back to you as soon as I know more.

Mara

Merci d'avance et bonne journée,
Mathilde Roux
Atelier Rue Cargo Lyon

messages.subject: Rear brake noise on K2: found it
messages.body:
Mara,

Got the three returned calipers from Utrecht on the bench. The anti-rattle shim in the rear caliper is the wrong thickness, 0.3 mm instead of 0.5 mm. It's the lot Corvid shipped in August (lot 0824). When it's wet the pad shifts a little and you get the squeal plus the rattle. Swapping the shim fixes it completely, about ten minutes per bike, no bleeding needed.

Jonas

messages.subject: Re: Rear brake noise on K2: found it
messages.body: Nice detective work. How many bikes got that lot? And can we get correct shims fast?

messages.subject: Re: Rear brake noise on K2: found it
messages.body: About 180 bikes, everything that shipped between Aug 20 and Sep 30. Corvid is sending 250 correct shim kits free of charge, they should be here next Monday. I can write the swap steps on half a page with photos if a shop needs them. Torque for the caliper bolts is 6 Nm.
